correctness.rationale: On a strict projection active face with k free and b=N-k clipped coordinates, KKT gives Q_s(x)_i=[x_i-lambda]_0^1. Tangent input perturbations v have sum zero and derivative v_i+sum_B v_j/k on free indices; clipped derivatives vanish. The restricted cube section bound with v_i=1 gives the exact face modulus 1+min(b,k-2)/k for k>=2, zero for k=1. Explicit zero-sum sign vectors attain both branches. Maximizing over k gives 2-2/(floor(N/2)+1); piecewise affine segment integration gives global upper bound. For each interior mass s, either s<k or s>b allows an active face with all b bound outputs equal 0 or 1, and a strict-face tangent witness attains the bound. For N=2 the feasible interior identity achieves 1. Independent exact vertex enumeration over 36 (N,k) cases N=2..9 and the explicit N=4 s=2 witness factor 4/3 corroborate the unrestricted argument.
